source_table: Tabella 5-2 'caratteristiche dei punti di emissione', PDF page 50 (printed page 46), SIA Allegato A rev01 (LSMIL031-DOC-G-022-4_rev01, August 2024)
source_crs: UTM zone 32 on WGS84 (EPSG:32632); the column header says km but the printed values are metres with comma decimals
method: Arithmetic mean of the eight server-hall generator stack coordinates (GEN_1-8, which the study places outside the west and east sides of the single MIL03 building), inverse-projected from EPSG:32632 to WGS84 with pyproj 3.7.1 (no datum change); GENSET9 (office generator) excluded from the mean
imagery_check: Qualitative only: in an Esri World Imagery export in EPSG:32632 (esri-ms-mil03-utm32.jpg) the nine stack points fall on an undeveloped field immediately north-east of an existing data-centre compound, matching the SIA description of an uncultivated agricultural plot in the former Italtel area next to existing data-centre buildings; imagery date unknown, not a status observation.
